title: Textbook outline
description: One entry of knowledge-eval/data/outline_<subject>_6up.json: the textbook's own table of contents, three levels only (unit / text title / board). Deliberately stops above 小节: every 教辅 divides sections differently, so a section-level baseline cannot be agreed on. `assessable: false` is a decision, not an omission, and has to carry a reason — see scripts/check_outline_coverage.py.

levels.description: Which levels this book actually has. Maths has units only; English has units and boards; 语文 has all three.

unit_names_from_textbook.description: True when the book prints a title for each unit (maths, English), so a chapter node's name must equal it. False for 语文, whose units carry a theme chosen by the editors rather than a printed title.

code.description: The aggregate node code this unit maps to. The check fails if no such chapter node exists.

kind.description: activity = the book's own ☆主题活动 (maths: 生活中的负数 / 体育中的数学 / 水是生命之源).
text = 课文标题, board = 习作 / 口语交际 / 语文园地 / 快乐读书吧 / 附录 等板块名.

contains.description: Names printed inside this entry: the three poems of 古诗词三首, the two 文言文, a 日积月累 poem, the 快乐读书吧 book title. They count as titles the book contains, and any one of them being referenced covers the entry.

source_work.description: The larger work a 课文 is taken from (少年闰土 ← 故乡). A question may name it without it being a 课文.

book_entries.description: Board-level items that belong to the whole book rather than to one unit (English appendices, Assessment I–III, Let's Know More).

retired_titles.description: Titles that used to be in this volume and are not any more. They must not come back — bracketed in a question or bare in a node's micro_nodes. This is the negative list behind the 2026-11 换课文: five texts left the book and the questions about them were still being served.
